design.acquisition_timing_boundary: Time only the registered acquisition callable; Context construction, GP fitting, allocation, final refits, and metrics are excluded.
design.fantasy_nesting: Generate production-ordered Zf[0:512] and Zg[0:512] banks with seed 0; use channel-wise prefixes for 128 and 256.
design.stratum_clustering: Average the two strata within seed before timing summaries, ratios, and agreement summaries.
design.timing_order: One process; seed then stratum; cyclically rotate the six variants within each seed-stratum cell.
design.total_timing_boundary: Entire run_trial call, including final refits and metrics.
